title: curie skill eval --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie skill eval --json`: the outcome roll-up plus one row per eval case.

failed.description: Cases the grader FAILED. Counted, never inferred as `total - passed`: a `plumbing_ok` row was never graded and is not a failure.

plumbing_ok.description: Cases that completed on the fake model and so were not graded at all (ADR-0055). Neither passes nor failures; `passed + failed + plumbing_ok == total`.

bundle_digest.description: sha256 of the tar.gz snapshot the evaluated runner mounted (#1087). Always present; null at the local/cluster tiers, which grade a deployed version rather than a locally snapshotted bundle, and on a skill run against a runner this checkout never recorded. Read it against `skill status --json`'s bundle_digest to confirm messaging and eval executed the same bundle.

bundle_revision.description: The deployed bundle revision a local/cluster run was routed to: the agent's in-force deployment (an active prod deployment outranks dev, then the most recent, the worker's own precedence) and the version it serves, read from the platform API before and after the run. Null at the skill tier, which names its bundle through bundle_digest; null when the lookup failed; and null when the two lookups disagree, since samples may then have run on different bundles. Optional: a payload from an earlier revision omits it.

environment.description: The deployment environment, for example prod or dev.

commit_sha.description: The commit the version was built from, when the platform recorded one.

bundle_sha256.description: sha256 of the bundle archive the platform stored for this version. The same computation as the skill tier's bundle_digest, so the two match for the same packed archive.

samples.description: Independent samples run per case (#1907). Default 1. Always emitted so a one-sample miss is labeled as one draw, not unexplained tier drift.

policy.description: How N sample verdicts reduce to one case outcome. Default majority.

outcome.description: The case's verdict. `plumbing_ok` is a third state, not a shade of pass or fail: the turn completed on the fake model, which returns one canned reply whatever the input, so no grader was run.

passed.description: Tri-state view of `outcome`: true for pass, false for fail, null for plumbing_ok. A non-graded row claims neither verdict, so it is null rather than a fabricated false.

output.description: The graded answer text (the reply judged). Empty when the turn produced no gradeable text. Carried so a failing case is diagnosable without a re-run (#548).

detail.description: Optional scorer explanation for this verdict. Present for a trajectory failure and omitted when the selected scorer has no additional evidence.

samples.description: Independent samples run for this case (#1907). Always emitted.

passes.description: How many of this case's samples passed the grader.

policy.description: Aggregation policy used to reduce the samples.

variance.description: Pass count over N when n>1, e.g. '2/3 samples passed (majority)'. Omitted at n=1.

trials.description: The raw record of every trial (independent sample) of this case, in run order, before aggregation reduced them to `outcome`. Present when the CLI drove the trials itself (skill, and the local/cluster in-CLI path); absent when the trials ran on the platform eval plane, which reports only the reduced verdict. Absence is not zero trials.

index.description: Zero-based position of this trial within its case.

outcome.description: This trial's own verdict, before aggregation.

passed.description: Tri-state view of this trial's outcome, as on the case row.

seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds for this trial alone.

reply.description: The reply text the grader judged. Empty when the turn produced none.

tool_calls.description: The tools this trial called, in emission order. Null when the tier cannot observe tool calls: local and cluster see only the delivered reply. An empty array is an observed turn that called no tool. Only names cross the runner wire, so arguments are not reported.

status.description: How the turn ended as the tier observed it: the runner's terminal session status at the skill tier (for example done or awaiting-approval), or the reply relay's outcome at local/cluster (replied, failed, awaiting_approval, completed_no_edit, timed_out). Omitted when no terminal frame arrived.

detail.description: Scorer explanation for this trial's verdict, when the scorer has one.

error.description: Why the turn did not complete or failed in the runner, when known.
